description: Use this when a user wants to know what Arc & Ledger sells at a fixed published price, or wants to buy one of those products (for example an EIN application, an S corporation election, an ITIN application, a tax extension, registered agent service, or an IRS notice review). Returns each product with its published price, billing interval, what it covers, and a first-party checkout link. Filter by category, by words, or by product id. Read-only: it does not take payment or place an order.

category.description: Limit the list to one catalog category (optional).

product_id.description: Return exactly one product by its catalog id, for example "ein-application" (optional).

query.description: Words to match against product names and descriptions, for example "EIN" or "S corp" (optional). Every word must match.
